test_fixed_point_basic: test the jax_fixed_point.fixed_point function with del2 and iteration methods against scipy.optimize.fixed_point
test_fixed_point_none: test the jax_fixed_point.fixed_point function with xtol=None to run maxiter iterations without tolerance check
build_fixed_point_solver: build a JAX-compatible fixed point solver supporting del2 Steffensen acceleration and plain iteration methods
create_fixed_point_with_args: create a fixed point computation by passing a callable, initial guess, and additional args tuple to jax_fixed_point.fixed_point
run_fixed_point_jit: run jax_fixed_point.fixed_point inside a jax.jit decorated function for compiled execution
